## Frontmatter key risk classification

From the union-of-keys pass (13 distinct keys across all 22 entries), for
use by Task 2's `metadata_policy: "validated"` adapters:

| Category | Keys | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Structural / permission — needs allowlisting, never blind-copy | `allowed-tools`, `user-invocable` | Direct tool-permission grant / visibility control |
| Path- or reference-bearing — needs validation before resolving | `sub_skills` (contains `path`), `benefits-from`, `parent_skill` | Could reference or resolve a filesystem path or another skill if trusted blindly |
| Freeform / opaque — risky only if an adapter's code parses it into config | `metadata` | Otherwise inert display text |
| Descriptive — safe to copy verbatim once presence is confirmed | `name`, `description`, `version`, `license`, `compatibility`, `preamble-tier`, `triggers` (alone, without `allowed-tools`) | No permission or path semantics on their own |

## Disposition Matrix

(Reproduced from the plan for a single-document reference; the plan is
canonical — see [`2026-08-14-gemini-skill-consolidation.md`](../superpowers/plans/2026-08-14-gemini-skill-consolidation.md#disposition-matrix).)

| Slug | Owner | End state | Rule |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent-methodology` | Orama | adapter | Preserve supported Gemini discovery metadata only. |
| `code-review`, `git-history-surgery`, `orama-afrp` | Orama | link or generated wrapper | Drop the unrelated local GLM fallback snippet. |
| `orama-gstack` | Orama | adapter | Target `bin/orama-system/gstack-gbrain/SKILL.md`, not stale `gstack`. |
| `orama-system`, `oramasys-method` | Orama | adapter | Current canonical cards subsume historical full bodies. |
| `perpetua-tools`, `perpetua-config`, `perpetua-hardware`, `perpetua-startup-intelligence` | Perpetua | cross-repo adapter | Resolve declared `PERPETUA_TOOLS_PATH` only. |
| `gstack-upgrade`, `skillify` | gstack | preserve-external | Record ownership and protect against overwrite. |

Review-only candidates: `autoplan`, `autoresearch`, `codex`, `deep-research`,
`diagram`, `kimi-webbridge`, `oramasys-skillify`, `setup-gbrain`, and
`sync-gbrain`. These are analysis-only until a later approved implementation
plan selects their disposition (Global Constraints).

## Reproducing this audit

```bash
python3 bin/orama-system/skills/skillify/scripts/install_thin_skill_wrappers.py --audit-gemini
```

The full command output covers all five roots (132 `gemini` rows plus the
`claude`/`codex`/`agents`/`antigravity` rows for the same slugs, useful for
spotting drift between roots); this document extracts only the 22
in-scope Gemini-root rows plus context. No `--reconcile-gemini`,
`--install`, or `--verify` call is required to produce it, and none was run
to produce it.
